test_set_tooltips_render: test the Styler.set_tooltips method renders CSS-based tooltips with hover visibility and content in HTML output
test_set_tooltips_ignored: test that Styler without set_tooltips produces no tooltip spans or title attributes in HTML
test_set_tooltips_custom_css: test the Styler.set_tooltips method with custom css_class and props parameters for styled tooltips
test_set_tooltips_as_title: test the Styler.set_tooltips method with as_title_attribute=True renders tooltips as HTML title attributes instead of CSS
test_set_tooltips_multiindex: test the Styler.set_tooltips method with MultiIndex and hidden index levels renders tooltips as title attributes correctly
